theme: Dark ocean-themed UI (Default) with EN/FR toggle

headings.usage: Headers, KPIs, Main Panel Titles. DO NOT use Space Grotesk.

body.usage: General text, lists, table cells, descriptions.

monospace.usage: Live agent logs, telemetry, coordinates, extraction statuses, API keys.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl. Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

rules.tinted_grey: Never use pure #000000. Always tint dark backgrounds with blue/navy (#020617).
rules.forbidden_colors: Teal green (#1B93A4) is explicitly forbidden for dashboards.
rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text against #0f172a. Active states must be vibrant but readable.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse. Items have subtle borders on right and bottom (border-slate-800/60). Remove last item borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for overlay panels floating over the Leaflet map. Must be bg-slate-900/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px inner stroke border-slate-700/50.
visual_enhancers.retro_futurism: Terminal Look for the 'Live Swarm Console'. Deep black background with scanline overlays, neon green/cyan text, and subtle text-shadow for a glow effect.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (dense dashboard weight) or lucide-react (default). Install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

grids.base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6

spans.primary_data: col-span-8 row-span-2 (e.g., Map or Main Telemetry)

grids.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure stretch. No jagged bottoms.

layouts.app_shell: 3-Column Mission Control Layout. Left Sidebar (Swarm Control), Center Main (Leaflet Map / Audit Grid), Right Sidebar (Settings & Thresholds).
layouts.header: Fixed top header with 'Blue Intelligence' (left), 'Maritime OSINT Swarm' subtitle, EN/FR toggle, and View Toggle (Map vs Audit) on the right. Must have solid or heavy glass background, not transparent.
layouts.spacing: Dense but structured. p-4 to p-6 inside panels. Massive spacing is for marketing; dashboards require precision and high data density.

components.SwarmControlPanel: Left Sidebar. Contains Status (Test/Full), 'Deploy TinyFish Swarm' (primary vibrant button), 'Stop Swarm' (danger button), Live Console.
components.LiveAgentConsole: Nested in Left Sidebar. Terminal aesthetic. Cards per active agent (TinyFish/Readability). PENDING/RUNNING statuses in colored monospace.
components.LeafletMap: Main center area. Clustered markers based on GeoJSON. Dark mode map tiles (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter). Popups must use the dark theme styling with precise padding.
components.AuditDashboard: Alternative Main View. Bento grid layout for KPIs (total extractions, success rate) and a dense Telemetry Table for active URLs, engines, durations.
components.SettingsPanel: Right Sidebar. Use Shadcn forms, sliders for map zoom/extraction concurrency. Select dropdown for Claude models. Dense layout.
components.Buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (max 4px radius). High contrast hover states. Deploy button uses a Tracing Beam or inner glow effect.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all rows/cards (slight bg shift).
motion.map_markers: Ping animation (pulsing ring) on active extraction nodes in the map.
motion.console: Smooth auto-scroll for the live agent logs. Blinking cursor effect for 'Agent active' state.

accessibility.contrast: Adhere to APCA guidelines. Ensure all cyan/green text is legible against deep navy.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='deploy-swarm-btn', data-testid='lang-toggle-en').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-cyan-500) on all inputs and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using standard Shadcn components but heavily override classes to remove the 'Vercel default' look. Go cardless or use flat rectangles with 1px border.
For the Map, use react-leaflet. Ensure the container has explicit height (e.g., h-full min-h-[600px]).
Implement the EN/FR translation strings natively via a simple context or dictionary file.
Create the data-testid attributes correctly in all components.
Apply 'flex-1 overflow-y-auto' to scrolling sidebars to keep the layout fixed and app-like.
Do not center-align the whole App. Align text left.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where necessary, like map overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp/minimal radius) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
